connector.name: Terraback
connector.registryDescription: Scan AWS/Azure/GCP and generate Terraform HCL with import blocks, deterministically, for AI agents.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package terraback. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bmoldo account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: TERRABACK_LICENSE
env.description: Optional offline license key (Ed25519-signed). Without it the server runs in the free Community tier with codify_batch capped at 25 resources per run.

env.name: ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID
env.description: Azure subscription ID for terraform plan verification with the azurerm provider (recommended when scanning Azure).
